findings.direction: Check eager RoPE table and expanded SDPA mask retention against recomputation
findings.reason: The source trials produced identical pixels with retained cos/sin or expanded masks, but those alternatives were slower and were discarded.
findings.revisit_when: On the target shapes, measure the work avoided and the lifetime and cost of the retained tensors in a paired end-to-end run.

findings.direction: Budget live NPU memory before retaining per-step masks and prompt tensors
findings.reason: That cache configuration exhausted device memory on the reported run. Its feasibility depends on what stays resident alongside the cached tensors.
findings.revisit_when: Inspect tensor lifetimes, allocator headroom and peak residency. Retry a paired test when the request shape or residency policy materially changes.

findings.direction: Qualify fusion attention with the actual mask, dtype and shape
findings.reason: The recorded fusion-attention runs, including precise=2 and precise=0 and steps without masks, showed either no gain or a gain below the source experiment’s keep criterion.
findings.revisit_when: Verify dispatch and numerical behavior for the present mask and tensor layout. Follow operator checks with a matched pipeline timing.

findings.direction: Recheck queueing and graph mode under the target stack
findings.reason: TASK_QUEUE_ENABLE=1/2 and enforce_eager=0 failed to improve the recorded eager configuration; some variants were slower.
findings.revisit_when: Confirm the execution route and scheduling overhead after a runtime change, with a fixed workload and equal warmups across arms.

findings.direction: Check initialization residency before combining RoPE, VAE and attention fast paths
findings.reason: The run with RoPE, the VAE fastpath and fusion attention ran out of memory during initialization. This identifies a failure phase for that particular combination.
findings.revisit_when: Measure what each component reserves during initialization before assembling another multi-path configuration.
findings.bounds: Triple-stack initialization, separate from later two-path requests on a busy host.

findings.direction: Qualify host headroom for the later RoPE and VAE reservation failure
findings.reason: A later run of the kept two-path stack on a busy host encountered resource-reservation failures. Fusion attention was not part of that stack.
findings.revisit_when: Check available device resources and contention on the target host before judging repeatability or timing.
findings.bounds: Later resource-reservation failure for the separate RoPE plus VAE stack.
